content:
- Finished the boundary cleanup in src/cli/config.rs and verified it with make lint and make test.
- Committed the work as a003f64 (Flatten CLI postgres TLS config boundary) and pushed it to origin/master.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully; it updated the Ralph task files, sent the status email, and printed the known rm warning for missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next if a new context window starts: read progress, inspect the freshly switched Ralph task files, and continue from the new task state.

- Read prior progress and confirmed the last boundary cleanup, push, and task switch were already completed in the previous context.
- Loaded improve-code-boundaries skill and confirmed it requires checking found_smells first, then solving exactly one boundary issue with code reduction.
- Verified Make targets: make test uses cargo nextest, so it is compatible with repo instructions; next I am checking found_smells and local AGENTS guidance before choosing a target area.

- Selected smell 10 in src/process/source.rs: a single-use validation helper fragmented source_from_member without providing a real boundary.
- Proved the helper call count using the required rename-and-make-check workflow; the compiler reported exactly one failing call site at src/process/source.rs:33.
- Inlined the validation into source_from_member and removed the helper; next I am running lint and the standard nextest-based test target before committing, pushing, and switching the Ralph task.

- make lint passed cleanly after the source boundary cleanup.
- make test passed with 244/244 tests green; nextest again reported 5 known leaky api::worker reload-certificates tests.
- Checked the add-bug skill and verified those leaks are already tracked in existing bug files, so I am not creating another duplicate bug task; next is commit, push, and task switch.
